strategy.summary: Hit each 1-6 target once to light the left spinner, shoot it from the right flipper into the top F-I-R-E lanes, and use Lane Change to complete F-I-R-E repeatedly for 5x Bonus X.

steps.text: Before the plunge, inspect Shield and the three eject-hole lamps.
modeNotes: Shield: This one-use left-outlane kicker returns a ball to play. Complete the configured target set to light it. An outlane save spends it. It can be earned again.
A Shield adjustment selects its qualifying targets. The adjustment does not prove that Shield starts lit. Read the lamp.

steps.text: Read the 1-6 targets. A flashing number is needed. A solid number is collected.
Plunge to an unlit F-I-R-E lane. Rotate the lamps with the right flipper button before the rollover.
modeNotes: FIRE: This four-lane top collection raises Bonus X. The right flipper button moves the lane progress.
Bonus X: Each FIRE completion raises this end-of-ball multiplier one step, to 5x. Treat it as per-ball progress unless the start lamps prove otherwise.

steps.text: On the first controlled ball, test the left spinner from the right flipper.
If the spinner is unlit, shoot only the needed 1-6 targets.
Each target scores 1,000. A newly collected flashing target adds one base-bonus advance.
Under factory settings, complete 1-2-3 or 4-5-6 to light Shield.
Complete all of 1-6 once.
modeNotes: The spinner lights for 1,000 per spin for the rest of the ball. It scores 100 per spin before qualification.
Two diagonal jet bumpers light. Lit jets score 1,000. Unlit jets score 100.
Factory three-ball rules also qualify two eject holes for lock.

steps.text: Transfer the ball to the right flipper. Shoot the lit left spinner.
Use the spinner feed to reach the top FIRE lanes.
Use Lane Change to guide the ball through a missing FIRE letter.
Repeat spinner and FIRE shots while their returns remain controlled.
Relight Shield with the configured target set after an outlane save spends it.
Let target, lane, and bumper hits build base bonus to 29,000. Finish the ball without tilting to collect as much as 145,000 at 5x.

fallback.title: Shield, targets, and controlled spinner feeds
fallback.when: Use this plan when the direct spinner rejects or the left-flipper transfer is poor.

steps.text: Cradle on the left flipper.
If Shield is off, hit the missing target in 1-2-3 or 4-5-6 under factory settings.
Confirm that Shield lights.
If the spinner is unlit, continue only the missing 1-6 targets.
Stop direct target shots after Shield and the spinner are ready.
Use a controlled transfer to the right flipper.
If the transfer is unsafe, shoot a qualified left eject hole.
If no left hole flashes, use the right orbit to reach the top lanes.
Use Lane Change for a missing FIRE letter.
Let the top feed return before another spinner attempt.

alternatives.title: Firepower Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this plan when eject-hole feeds are controlled and a three-ball safety net helps the normal scoring route.

steps.text: Complete 1-6 once and read the flashing eject holes.
modeNotes: Lock Lamp: This stored qualification belongs to an eject hole. A flashing hole spends one lamp by holding the ball. A lit occupied hole remains filled until multiball or a rule release.
Firepower Multiball: Three held balls start three-ball play. Normal scoring remains active. There is no jackpot, scoring multiplier, or exclusive multiball shot.
Factory three-ball rules flash two eject holes after the first 1-6 completion.

steps.text: Shoot a flashing eject hole. It scores 10,000 and holds the ball.
An unlit eject hole scores 1,000 and returns the same ball.
Use the served replacement ball to complete 1-6 a second time.
The second same-ball completion qualifies the third hole and lights all four jets.
Fill the remaining flashing holes. The third lock releases all three balls.
During multiball, use spinner, lane, target, bumper, bonus, and Shield scoring.
Multiball ends when one ball remains. Requalify and fill all three holes for another start.

alternatives.title: FIRE and Extra Ball
alternatives.when: Use this plan when spinner or orbit feeds make Lane Change reliable and replay balls have tournament value.

steps.text: Send the ball through the spinner or right orbit to the top lanes.
Use Lane Change to move a missing FIRE letter under the ball.
Each lane scores 1,000. A newly collected lane adds one base-bonus advance.
Roll through all four F-I-R-E lanes; the completed set lights FIRE and raises Bonus X.
Repeat until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Under factory rules, complete FIRE once more after 5x.
modeNotes: POWER: This three-target middle-right bank scores 10,000 when complete. It lights POWER and both inlanes. Each lit inlane scores 3,000 and adds three base-bonus advances.
Extra Ball: This replay award lights at the center POWER target. Hitting the target spends the lit award. SHOOT AGAIN serves the replay ball after the current drain.

steps.text: When Extra Ball lights at the center POWER target, hit that target to collect it.
If the Extra Ball insert does not light, leave this route and return to the spinner.
No more than two Extra Balls can be awarded on one ball.

alternatives.title: POWER and Firepower Bonus
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the three middle-right targets are safe or complete incidentally.

steps.text: Complete the three POWER targets.
modeNotes: Firepower Bonus: This stored 10,000, 30,000, or 50,000 award needs both FIRE and POWER. Completing the pair collects the lit value. The next pair advances the value.

steps.text: Complete FIRE at the top.
Complete whichever of F-I-R-E or P-O-W-E-R remains; completing the pair collects the current Firepower Bonus.
The factory sequence is 10,000, then 30,000, then 50,000.
Repeat POWER and FIRE for the next value.
After the factory 50,000 collect, read the outlane Special lamps.
modeNotes: Special: This configured replay award lights one or both outlanes after a selected Firepower Bonus collect. It can award a credit, Extra Ball, or points.

steps.text: Use the Special only when an outlane Special lamp is on; one or both outlanes can be active.
Do not shoot P-O-W-E-R solely for Shield unless the Shield lamp confirms that target set is active.

alternatives.title: Lit-bumper route
alternatives.when: Use this scoring only when the ball reaches the jet bumpers naturally.

steps.text: Complete 1-6 once. Two diagonal jet bumpers light.
Each jet hit changes which two jets are lit.
A lit jet scores 1,000. An unlit jet scores 100.
Complete 1-6 a second time on the same ball.
All four jets light for the rest of that ball.
Do not force a center-target rebound only to enter the jets.
Complete 1-6 once to light the spinner and first lock lamps.
When the left-outlane Shield lamp is off, complete the active Shield target set shown by the machine's target lamps.
Shoot the lit spinner for 1,000 per spin.
Complete FIRE repeatedly to reach 5x.
Use target, lane, and bumper hits to build base bonus to 29,000.
Complete 1-6 again to qualify the third lock.
Fill all three eject holes. Start Firepower Multiball.
Use multiball to complete FIRE and POWER without a jackpot obligation.
Drain without tilting to collect up to 145,000 bonus.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm original Williams code and production 1-6 standups. Prototypes and replacement rules ROMs can use different targets or rules.
Read Functions 30 and 31. Factory three-ball play uses Function 31 setting 03; Williams recommends setting 02 for five-ball play.
Read Function 32 before using Shield. Factory setting 01 accepts either 1-2-3 or 4-5-6 on one ball, or a stored 1-6 completion.

techniques.name: Right-flipper spinner shot
techniques.instruction: Transfer controlled balls to the right flipper. Shoot the left spinner from there.

techniques.name: Thumb plunge lock
techniques.instruction: When the upper-right eject hole flashes, use a firm thumb plunge. The ball can rebound from the one-way gate into the hole. Do not use a fist strike.

techniques.name: Lane Change
techniques.instruction: Tap the right flipper button before a top rollover. Rotate a missing FIRE letter under the ball.

techniques.name: Target-edge graze
techniques.instruction: Graze the edge of a needed target when a full hit returns dangerously. Test this only after the rebound is known.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: During a spinner feed, use a small legal nudge toward a missing FIRE lane. Combine it with Lane Change.

cautions.issue: A soft spinner miss can hit the orbit rubber and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Make a firm shot or prepare for the same-side feed.
Hit only the missing target. Stop after Shield and the spinner are ready.

cautions.issue: A slow ball can fall between the jet bumpers and drain through the center.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready until the ball exits the bumper area.

cautions.issue: A tilt can erase lock and Bonus X progress.
cautions.response: Use smaller nudges after locks or 5x are ready.

cautions.issue: Eject-hole kickouts are normally controlled feeds, but copies differ.
cautions.response: Use one early eject to learn the return before depending on it as a transfer.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Hit each 1-6 target once to light the left spinner, shoot it from the right flipper into the top F-I-R-E lanes, and use Lane Change to complete F-I-R-E repeatedly for 5x Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Complete 1-6 once to light the spinner and first lock lamps.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Shield, targets, and controlled spinner feeds: Use this plan when the direct spinner rejects or the left-flipper transfer is poor.

quickInfo.name: Lock settings
quickInfo.summary: Functions 27 and 33-35 change replay treatment, Firepower Bonus memory, Extra Ball, and outlane Special behavior.

strategy.simpleOverview: Completing targets 1 through 6 in Firepower lights the left spinner. That spinner feeds the top F-I-R-E lanes, and each completed F-I-R-E set raises Bonus X. The built bonus scores when the ball ends without a tilt.
strategy.overview: Firepower is a bonus-building game centered on the 1-6 targets, the left spinner, and F-I-R-E. Complete 1-6, repeat the lit spinner into the top lanes, and use Lane Change to finish F-I-R-E until Bonus X reaches 5x. During Multiball, keep using that same bonus and spinner loop because Multiball adds no Jackpot ladder.
